ns2:section.sectionText: Registration in this section is restricted to students who have earned a Bachelors Degree. This section is open to off-campus students only. The live sessions for this course will occur on Thursday's from 11:00am-12:30pm, 6:00-7:30pm and 7:45-9:15pm central standard time.
